blocks.title: About me
blocks.body:
I am an independent textile agent based in Santo Tirso, in the heart of Portugal's textile and clothing industry.

I work as the link between European brands and the factories that make their product. My focus is outdoor and casual apparel, and I know the manufacturers of the northern corridor first hand.

Alongside the Portuguese factories, I work with production partners in Asia for workwear, outdoor and casual lines.
